note: Floor enforced by tools/ci/check-coverage-floor.sh in the coverage CI job (issues #185 and #244). Current measurement: 82.1% over 29 instrumented src/ files; the percentage floor carries a small margin for gcov attribution differences between gcc versions. Raise the floor as coverage improves — never lower it to silence a failure. required_instrumented_files (issue #244, M3 clause 1) pins by name the sources that must stay instrumented — the core engine (packet_processing.c, hash_utils.cpp), the classifier helpers (mmt_tcpip_classif_utils.c) and the business-app plugin (mmt_business_app.c, proto_ips_data.c) — matched against summary.json's instrumented_sources, so a suite silently dropping one fails even when the raw count still holds. Baseline history: the #177 integration re-baselined this floor — the new dicom, ndn_dissector and avl suites widened instrumentation from 6 to 9 files, and the #200 hash_utils.cpp rewrite added defensive paths the suites do not yet exercise, moving the aggregate from 87.1% to 78.2%. The #241 core_engine suite widened instrumentation from 9 to 17 files (packet_processing.c, hash_utils.cpp and their link closure) at 78.3%. The #243 business_app and proto_classifiers suites widened instrumentation from 17 to 29 files (mmt_business_app.c, proto_ips_data.c, proto_dcerpc.c, proto_ptp.c, proto_syslog.c plus their link closure) at 82.1%; the instrumented-files floor was raised to 29 and the line floor to 80.0. The instrumented-files counter remains the guard against suites silently losing instrumentation. See docs/DECISIONS.md.

sdk.note: Whole-SDK accounting enforced by tools/ci/check-sdk-coverage.sh in the coverage CI job (issue #388, F-TEST-004) over tests/coverage/coverage-combined.info. whole_sdk_line_pct floors the default-build families (core, tcpip, handwritten mobile, business_app, dicom; generated asn1c, vendored llhttp and the optional ENABLESEC=1 security_fuzz cohort excluded): first measurement 46.03% (15,126/32,858 lines, 715 files), floor set 1 point lower for gcov attribution differences between gcc versions and architectures. original_cohort pins by name the 30 sources of the audit's 82.9% (5,660/6,831) unit-suite measurement at commit 2ab7b73 (list recovered by re-running tests/run_all_tests.sh --coverage at that commit); it is measured on the combined records: 83.29% (5,854/7,028) at issue #388, unit-only 82.87%. excluded_sources justifies every tracked handwritten source that has no measured record. Raise floors as coverage improves — never lower them to silence a failure.
